module: Node "Is Player usable" (category `repeat_instant`). Reads `playerUsable` of a vehicle. Input pin: `vehId`; outputs: flow `true` and flow `false`.
notes: Bug: if `vehId` is nil or 0, the `else` is empty, so `source` stays nil and `source.playerUsable` causes an error (no fallback to the player).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.
